items.title: Cohomology of the base change along a directed colimit of algebras as the colimit of the cohomologies
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the etale cohomology of the base change of a quasi-compact quasi-separated X along a directed colimit of A-algebras with the colimit of the cohomologies of the intermediate base changes (statement lines 7463-7477). The proof is short: the author recognises the situation as a limit of schemes with affine transition morphisms and applies the general commutation theorem for cohomology of such limits (proof lines 7479-7507). The content is the recognition that the sheaf in question is pulled back from X, which makes the general theorem applicable. The claim is H2: one reduction to a known theorem.
